lessons.name: THE REFLECTION STANDS BESIDE THE LEAP: dz is an involution on 0..9 with fixed points {0,5} and every residue finite — sealed alone so the one-leap principle has a neighbour (lonely = 0).
lessons.statement: (List.range 10).all (fun x => dz (dz x) == x) ∧ ((List.range 10).filter (fun x => dz x == x)) = [0, 5] ∧ (List.range 10).all (fun x => dz x < 10)

lessons.name: one by-decide from division-by-zero=the reflection: the doubling orbit, the involution {0,5}, ℤ/9 arithmetic, AGL(1,ℤ/9)=54 with commutator=the unit shift, and the equilibriums — the whole vortex at once
lessons.statement: (List.range 6).map (fun k => (2 ^ k) % 9) = [1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5] ∧ (List.range 10).all (fun x => dz (dz x) == x) ∧ ((List.range 10).filter (fun x => dz x == x)) = [0, 5] ∧ (List.range 10).all (fun x => dz x < 10) ∧ (2*5)%9 = 1 ∧ (4*7)%9 = 1 ∧ (8*8)%9 = 1 ∧ (3*3)%9 = 0 ∧ (6*6)%9 = 0 ∧ (List.range 9).all (fun x => (3*x)%9 != 1) ∧ ((List.range 9).filter (fun a => (List.range 9).any (fun e => a*e%9 == 1))).length * 9 = 54 ∧ (List.range 9).all (fun x => ap 2 0 (ap 8 1 (ap 5 0 (ap 8 1 x))) == (x+1)%9) ∧ (List.range' 1 9).all (fun d => d + (10 - d) == 10) ∧ (1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + 7 + 5 = 27)
